concept: A paused map-folding portrait in a restored ferry terminal at autumn dusk, with an elbow triangle, asymmetric supported pose inside bilateral architecture, and moving travelers behind a crisp figure.

all_of: A clearly seated primary adult figure
Head is the upper vertex
Two outward elbows are both visible below the head as separated lower vertices
Elbow triangle belongs to the body and is legible in the same view
Forearms have plausible knee support
false_substitutes: A triangle in the map or architecture without a body triangle
A head and two knees substituted for the frozen head-and-elbow relation
One elbow hidden so the triangle must be imagined

all_of: Central doorway or axis present
Matching left and right arches and lamps visible together
Upright columns and level floor lines retain a level surrounding frame
Primary figure has visibly different elbow heights and a tilted shoulder or head line
false_substitutes: Only the figure centered in an unrelated asymmetric room
Camera tilt offered as body asymmetry
A symmetric pose in a symmetric room
One side of architecture outside the frame

all_of: Primary eyes, face, map and hands sharply stationary
At least two crossing travelers in the passages behind the bench
Directional/translucent motion trails attach to moving travelers
Architecture and bench remain sharp
false_substitutes: Uniform defocus or bokeh described as motion
Camera shake affecting the whole frame
Moving subject against a crisp static background
Only ambient light trails without the specified travelers

all_of: Visible facial/hair guidance consistent with supplied appearance
Dark chin-length bob and wispy parted bangs
Readable both eyes and face
Adult portrayal
false_substitutes: Reference features only named in prose
Face obscured by effects or props

all_of: Partly folded creased paper map visibly held across lap
Hips supported by bench
Left foot on floor and right foot on low step are assessable
Both forearms supported by separated knees
false_substitutes: An open book or blank tablet replaces the folded map
Unclear support because feet are cropped or hidden

all_of: Stone bench and paired terminal passageways read together
Wicker basket containing dry clustered hydrangea flowers beside bench
Two warm wall lamps and cool dim entrance light visible
false_substitutes: Bright daytime exterior offered as dusk
Only one lighting color across the frame

review_policy.decision_rule: all_of in one exact saved image

nonpixel_context: Exact autumn season and venue historical restoration cannot be established from one indoor portrait; authored setting labels are contextual, while visible scene cues above are tested.
